datasetPurpose: Append-only event outcomes for historical analysis and forecast calibration. Existing records should be corrected with an audit note, never silently overwritten. QQQ 15m and 1h measure price changes at exact release windows when available.

analysisFields.eventKey: Stable recurring event family used to compare like-for-like releases
analysisFields.surpriseDirection: Direction of the result versus the prevailing expectation
analysisFields.nasdaqReactionDirection: Observed Nasdaq response when independently verifiable
analysisFields.confounders: Other simultaneous factors that may weaken causal attribution
analysisFields.qqqReaction: Massive adjusted QQQ minute-bar closes: last completed minute before the release versus last completed minute at +15m and +60m; values are observed QQQ moves, not causal effect or Nasdaq Composite returns
analysisFields.reactionWindows: Scheduled release time and exact pre-release, +15m, +60m observed closes for QQQ/NVDA/SMH; multiple independently timed releases stay separate; null indicates a missing exact minute bar.

results.expected: Manufacturing 53.6; services 56.0; no reliable composite consensus identified
results.surprise: Broad upside surprise; fastest composite growth since July 2021
results.yield10y: Rose about 14 bp to roughly 5.11%, the highest since 2007
results.explanation: Activity, new orders, employment and price signals were strong enough to raise expectations for an October Fed hike. The resulting surge in Treasury yields increased the discount rate on long-duration technology earnings and reversed the Nasdaq from the prior day’s record. Higher oil and company-specific weakness were additional headwinds, so the full-day move was not attributable to PMI alone.

results.previous: The U.S.–China trade truce had been due to expire in November.
results.expected: Continued truce widely expected; no reliable consensus for a broader deal.
results.actual: Two-month trade-truce extension; no comprehensive agreement on tariffs, rare earths or technology announced.
results.surprise: Limited extension rather than a durable broader agreement; no numeric consensus or measurable release-time surprise.
results.explanation: The summit preserved a temporary trade truce but left major tariff, rare-earth, AI and Taiwan questions open. Oil, yields and the 7-year Treasury auction also affected the trading day, so its index moves cannot be assigned to the summit alone.
